names.name: The novelty shop
names.said: Bacon on a maple bar was a joke once.

text.what: A shop that competes on invention: unusual toppings, themed rooms, names that are jokes, and a queue that photographs its order.
text.story:
Voodoo Doughnut opened in Portland in May 2003, night-only until 2006, with a logo carrying Baron Samedi. Psycho Donuts opened in Campbell, California in March 2009 with a straitjacket on the wall and donuts named after mental-health conditions, which has drawn objection. Doughnut Plant, from 1994, took the opposite route: invention aimed at pastry rather than at spectacle.

*Inference —* the novelty shop's real product is a photograph, which is why it prices above a strip-mall counter and why it ages faster.
text.today: The form spread nationally in the 2010s and the strip-mall shops largely ignored it.
